value.value: redefinition of '\w+' shadows declaration in the outer scope
value.note: the reported symptom: HV2021 prints no -Wfor-redefinition shadow warning for the repro's inner-scope 'i' that shadows the outer-scope 'i'.

anti-vacuity anchor: the repro must actually finish compiling to DXIL disassembly (dxc's default no -Fo behaviour is to print it to stdout). Without this, a build that simply failed to parse the shader would also satisfy the absence clause above for the wrong reason -- see the invalid-probe/absence-predicate trap in SKILL.md step 4.

note: Symptom present = the -HV 2021 compile of repro.hlsl (a loop induction variable 'i' that shadows an outer-scope 'i') prints no shadow-redefinition warning, while a successful compile still happened. See variant-hv2018-control-<compiler>.txt and variant-hv2016-control-<compiler>.txt for the same source under older language versions, which DO print the warning and are the positive control (--expect match) proving the predicate can detect the warning when it is present.
